title: Tonopah Test Range is literally Area 52

tellings.quote: the tonap test range. Ton of test range is literally named Area 52.

plain: The Tonopah Test Range, a secretive military testing ground in Nevada, is said to be literally named Area 52, a sibling to the famous secret base Area 51. An online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb says so on Michels' show, stating it as a known fact without naming a source. The point is that the classified work people associate with Area 51 may also have a lesser-known neighbour.
